subject: CORRECTION #2 + botpack regenerated: unlock timing is PER SLOT (earliest tower 3 g, earliest barracks 10 g in Nordfels)
body:
My previous correction still generalized from ONE slot per building type. Measured properly over all slots (reference\botpack\by-scene\Nordfels.json, fields slots[].unlockAfterUpgradeNumber / unlockCostGold / rootId / requiredRootLevelDifference / followsActivatorUpgrades — regenerated, all 37 scenes):
Nordfels, cumulative prerequisite gold before the slot can be built at all:
  0 g: Castle Center
  3 g (castle upgrade #1): 2x Defense Tower, 3x Mill, 6x Shrine, 2x Summoning Circle, 1x Blacksmith, 1x House
  6 g: 6x Field (Mill upgrade #1)     10 g (castle #1+#2): 1x Barracks, 1x Archery Range, 4x Defense Tower, 2x House, 9x Field (Mill #2), 1x Wall
  30 g (castle #1+#2+#3): 1x Barracks, 1x Archery Range, 4x Defense Tower, 1x House, 3x Wall     (+ House chains 5-16 g via other houses; wall chain 14/33 g)
=> the FIRST tower can be built after only 3 g of castle spend, the first Barracks/Archery Range after 10 g; NOT 30 g. Use slots[].unlockCostGold per slot (not per building type). Rule of thumb from the code: slot appears when its activator is bought for the (activatorLevel+1)-th time (BuildSlot.Activate, BuildSlot.cs:685).
Upgrade cap: past level 0 a slot can only be upgraded while root.Level > level + requiredRootLevelDifference (BuildSlot.CanBeUpgraded); with diff 0 (barracks, towers, houses...) its level is capped by the CASTLE level; walls (diff 1) need castle level >= wall level + 2.
Lesson applied on my side: every per-type statement in the handbook pages now shows the distribution over slots ('Slot appears when ... (count)'), not the first slot. The loader sketch has the new BpSlot fields; regression test still PASS.
